description: Configuration schema for visual testing tool Chromatic
title: Chromatic Config File Schema

autoAcceptChanges.description: If there are any changes to the build, automatically accept them. Only for given branch, if specified.
autoAcceptChanges.markdownDescription: If there are any changes to the build, automatically accept them. Only for given branch, if specified.

buildCommand.description: The command that builds your Storybook. Use this if your Storybook build command does not exist in the "scripts" field of your package.json.Requires --output-dir.
buildCommand.markdownDescription:
The command that builds your Storybook. Use this if your Storybook build command does not exist in the "scripts" field of your package.json.
Requires `--output-dir`.

buildScriptName.description: The npm script that builds your Storybook. Use this if your Storybook build script is named differently.
buildScriptName.markdownDescription: The npm script that builds your Storybook. Use this if your Storybook build script is named differently.

debug.description: Output verbose debugging information. This option implies interactive: false
debug.markdownDescription: Output verbose debugging information. This option implies `interactive: false`

diagnosticsFile.description: When enabled, write process context information to a JSON file.Defaults to chromatic-diagnostics.json
diagnosticsFile.markdownDescription:
When enabled, write process context information to a JSON file.
Defaults to `chromatic-diagnostics.json`

exitOnceUploaded.description: Exit with status 0 (OK) once the built version has been published to Chromatic. Only for given branch, if specified.
exitOnceUploaded.markdownDescription: Exit with status `0` (OK) once the built version has been published to Chromatic. Only for given branch, if specified.

exitZeroOnChanges.description: If all snapshots render, but there are visual changes, exit with code 0 rather than the usual exit code 1. Only for given branch, if specified.
exitZeroOnChanges.markdownDescription: If all snapshots render, but there are visual changes, exit with code `0` rather than the usual exit code `1`. Only for given branch, if specified.

externals.description: Disable TurboSnap when any of these files have changed since the baseline build.Requires onlyChanged.
externals.markdownDescription:
Disable [TurboSnap](https://www.chromatic.com/docs/turbosnap) when any of these files have changed since the baseline build.
Requires `onlyChanged`.

ignoreLastBuildOnBranch.description: Do not use the last build on this branch as a baseline if it is no longer in history (i.e., the branch was rebased).
ignoreLastBuildOnBranch.markdownDescription: Do not use the last build on this branch as a baseline if it is no longer in history (i.e., the branch was rebased).

junitReport.description: When enabled, write the build results to a JUnit XML file.Defaults to chromatic-build-{buildNumber}.xml where the {buildNumber} will be replaced with the actual build number.
junitReport.markdownDescription:
When enabled, write the build results to a JUnit XML file.
Defaults to `chromatic-build-{buildNumber}.xml` where the `{buildNumber}` will be replaced with the actual build number.

logFile.description: Write CLI logs to a file. Defaults to chromatic.log
logFile.markdownDescription: Write CLI logs to a file. Defaults to `chromatic.log`

fileHashing.description: Enabling this option will turn off the built-in file hashing mechanism, leading to all the files being uploaded to Chromatic on every build.
fileHashing.markdownDescription: Enabling this option will turn off the built-in file hashing mechanism, leading to all the files being uploaded to Chromatic on every build.

onlyChanged.description: Enables TurboSnap.Runs Chromatic for stories affected by files and dependencies that have changed since the baseline build, including the specified branch if provided.
onlyChanged.markdownDescription:
Enables [TurboSnap](https://www.chromatic.com/docs/turbosnap).
Runs Chromatic for stories affected by files and dependencies that have changed since the baseline build, including the specified branch if provided.

onlyStoryFiles.description: Only run a single story or a subset of stories by their filename(s). Specify the full path to the story file relative to the root of your Storybook project.
onlyStoryFiles.markdownDescription: Only run a single story or a subset of stories by their filename(s). Specify the full path to the story file relative to the root of your Storybook project.

onlyStoryNames.description: Only run a single story or a subset of stories by their name.
onlyStoryNames.markdownDescription: Only run a single story or a subset of stories by their name.

outputDir.description: Relative path to target directory for building your Storybook. Use this if you want to preserve it for other tasks.
outputDir.markdownDescription: Relative path to target directory for building your Storybook. Use this if you want to preserve it for other tasks.

projectId.description: The unique identifier for your project, sometimes referred to as appId.
projectId.markdownDescription: The unique identifier for your project, sometimes referred to as `appId`.

projectToken.description: DEPRECATED The secret token for your project. Prefer to use CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN instead if you can.
projectToken.markdownDescription: DEPRECATED The secret token for your project. Prefer to use `CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN` instead if you can.

skip.description: Skip Chromatic tests, but mark the commit as passing. It avoids blocking PRs due to required merge checks. Only for given branch, if specified.
skip.markdownDescription: Skip Chromatic tests, but mark the commit as passing. It avoids blocking PRs due to required merge checks. Only for given branch, if specified.

storybookBaseDir.description: Relative path from repository root to Storybook project root.Use with onlyChanged and storybookBuildDir when your Storybook is located in a subdirectory of your repository.
storybookBaseDir.markdownDescription:
Relative path from repository root to Storybook project root.
Use with `onlyChanged` and `storybookBuildDir` when your Storybook is located in a subdirectory of your repository.

storybookBuildDir.description: If you have already built your Storybook, provide the path to the static build directory.
storybookBuildDir.markdownDescription: If you have already built your Storybook, provide the path to the static build directory.

storybookConfigDir.description: Relative path from where you run Chromatic to your Storybook config directory.Use with onlyChanged and storybookBuildDir when using a custom --config-dir flag for Storybook.
storybookConfigDir.markdownDescription:
Relative path from where you run Chromatic to your Storybook config directory.
Use with `onlyChanged` and `storybookBuildDir` when using a custom [`--config-dir`](https://storybook.js.org/docs/api/cli-options#build) flag for Storybook.

storybookLogFile.description: Write Storybook build logs to a custom file path.
storybookLogFile.markdownDescription: Write Storybook build logs to a custom file path.

traceChanged.description: Print dependency trace for changed files to affected story files. Set to "expanded" to list individual modules.Requires onlyChanged.
traceChanged.markdownDescription:
Print dependency trace for changed files to affected story files. Set to "expanded" to list individual modules.
Requires `onlyChanged`.

untraced.description: Disregard these files and their dependencies when tracing dependent stories for TurboSnap.Requires onlyChanged.
untraced.markdownDescription:
Disregard these files and their dependencies when tracing dependent stories for [TurboSnap](https://www.chromatic.com/docs/turbosnap).
Requires `onlyChanged`.

uploadMetadata.description: Upload Chromatic metadata files as part of the published Storybook. This option implies diagnosticsFile: true and logFile: true
uploadMetadata.markdownDescription: Upload Chromatic metadata files as part of the published Storybook. This option implies `diagnosticsFile: true` and `logFile: true`

zip.description: Publish your Storybook to Chromatic as a single zip file instead of individual content files.
zip.markdownDescription: Publish your Storybook to Chromatic as a single zip file instead of individual content files.

playwright.description: Use your Playwright tests to power visual tests with Chromatic. Learn more
playwright.markdownDescription: Use your Playwright tests to power visual tests with Chromatic. [Learn more](https://www.chromatic.com/docs/playwright)

cypress.description: Use your Cypress tests to power visual tests with Chromatic. Learn more
cypress.markdownDescription: Use your Cypress tests to power visual tests with Chromatic. [Learn more](https://www.chromatic.com/docs/cypress)
